universe.name: IWV historical constituents
universe.snapshot_rule: latest target_snapshot_date <= formation close; source_snapshot_date <= target_snapshot_date; no backward fill before first snapshot
universe.identity_rule: exact full SID equals security_id and identity_usable is true; no ticker or SID-prefix matching
universe.zero_weight_rows: retain usable membership; disclosed zero weights may be rounded
universe.investability_filters: retain existing USD statements, market cap >=100m USD, raw price >=5 USD, ADV21 >=1m USD and price-contract checks
universe.portfolio_weighting: IWV weights are not portfolio weights; unchanged score, quintile and FMP methods

component_transform: direction-adjusted (average rank - 0.5) / N on the final complete formation universe
dimension_transform: equal component percentile mean, then normal quantile of its cross-sectional percentile, demeaned and divided by population SD
combined_signal: equal-weight mean of standardized dimension exposures; displayed score is its cross-sectional percentile times 100
missing_policy: require every specified raw component, no zero imputation or time-varying reweighting
control_transform: rank normal, capitalization-weighted mean centered, equal-weight population SD
fmp_weighting: sqrt market capitalization in the WLS objective; weighted QR
fmp_combination: equal dimension unit-exposure budgets; combine raw FMP weights before netting and scaling the aggregate to gross 2
fmp_comparison_universe: both control variants require all six controls, enabling a matched comparison; no residual-risk history is used
regimes: baseline always active when score exists; RF before score availability and outside selected reporting regime; switching turnover not recomputed
